As the EU's new transparency requirements for AI-generated content officially take effect, WhatsApp is developing a new feature that lets channel admins tag specific types of AI-generated content. Details below.

"Channel admins in your country must label channel updates that use AI content"

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is working on a new feature that lets channel admins flag certain types of content as AI-generated.

References to this new feature can currently be found in the latest WhatsApp beta for Android, but since the feature seems designed to address regulatory requirements in specific countries, it's expected that an iOS version will follow and that availability will be expanded.

According to the report, the new feature will follow the same flow channel admins currently use when posting sponsored content:

WABetaInfo notes that not all AI-generated content must be labelled. As the current splash screen describes, AI content includes images, videos, or other media created or edited with AI tools.

In other words, admins don't appear to have to label AI-generated text. It's still unclear whether this option will roll out globally or only in areas where the law requires such labelling.
